items.title: Barry Kernfeld interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 16, 2020

ctx.x: Because that’s my favorite record in the world.

I was completely astonished. What were they thinking? I mean so those two tracks, “Save Your Love for Me” and “Never Will I Marry,” okay, as a Grove editor you have to be brutal. I’m dealing with tens of thousands of people and hundreds of thousands of recordings. Sometimes I’ll listen to something just once. Often I’ll listen to something just once, because I don’t have time to do it more than that. Sometimes I won’t even make it all the way through just once, it’ll be three minutes in and I’ll say all right,…
A student of mine just sent me —
